test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: general
question: A bus covered a distance of 162 km. If speed of this bus is 15 m/s, then what will be the time taken ?
solution: __Shortcut Trick__ Convert speed from m/s to kmph: 15 × (18/5) = 3 × 18 = 54 kmph. Time = Distance ÷ Speed = 162 ÷ 54 = 3 hours. **∴ The correct answer is 3 hours.** **__Alternate Method__** Given: Distance = 162 km, Speed = 15 m/s. Formula Used: Time = Distance ÷ Speed; 1 m/s = 18/5 kmph.
